pr_title: Bound the time a pattern scan takes

comments.comment: scan skips every added line over 10,000 characters, so an author who pads a forbidden line past that length passes the check it exists to enforce.
comments.failureScenario: A pull request adds the line it.only("works", () => { followed by 10,000 spaces and a closing comment. The line is longer than maxLineLength, scan returns before matching it, and the focused-test rule reports nothing, so the pull request merges with the rest of that suite skipped; the base flagged the line.
